description: Small labelled real-footage set for the theft-detection module. Media is NOT in the repository: run demo/fetch_sample_footage.py. Labels were made by watching each clip. Nine clips is far too few to estimate real-world accuracy; this set checks that the real pipeline runs end to end and records concrete failures.
